description: We are a two-person team (Irfan Khattak and Mohammad Abdullah) who built the CLPS Lunar South Pole Horizon Browser a standalone, high-fidelity simulation and coordinate analysis engine. Using Python and ML, it bypasses legacy APIs to calculate orbital kinematics, thermodynamics, and 3D terrain navigation locally. We are not accepting additional members, as our architecture, physics engine, and UI are fully developed and ready for submission.
